# Explicit negation is distinct from absence of a fact.
# A preference applies only when competing rules have satisfied antecedents.

facts = {
    ("dollars", "badger", 88),
    ("dollars", "frog", 72),
    ("friends", "frog", 13),
    ("movie_year", "frog", 1971),
    ("name", "frog", "Cinnamon"),
    ("name", "dachshund", "Chickpea"),
}

money = {f[1]: f[2] for f in facts if f[0] == "dollars"}
friends = {f[1]: f[2] for f in facts if f[0] == "friends"}
movie_year = {f[1]: f[2] for f in facts if f[0] == "movie_year"}
messi_birth_year = 1987

if money["frog"] > money["badger"]:
    facts.add(("more_money_than_badger", "frog"))
if movie_year["frog"] < messi_birth_year:
    facts.add(("movie_before_messi_birth", "frog"))
if friends["frog"] > 9:
    facts.add(("more_than_nine_friends", "frog"))

animals = ("badger", "dachshund", "frog", "mule",
           "swallow", "rhino", "poodle")
rules = []

for animal in animals:
    rules.append((
        "Rule1",
        frozenset({
            ("not_surrenders", animal, "mule"),
            ("neglects", animal, "swallow"),
        }),
        ("not_suspects", animal, "rhino"),
    ))
    rules.append((
        "Rule4",
        frozenset({("surrenders", animal, "poodle")}),
        ("suspects", animal, "rhino"),
    ))

rules.extend([
    ("Rule2", frozenset({("more_money_than_badger", "frog")}),
     ("neglects", "frog", "swallow")),
    ("Rule3", frozenset({("movie_before_messi_birth", "frog")}),
     ("neglects", "frog", "swallow")),
    ("Rule5", frozenset({("more_than_nine_friends", "frog")}),
     ("surrenders", "frog", "poodle")),
])

closure = set(facts)
while True:
    additions = {
        conclusion
        for _, premises, conclusion in rules
        if premises <= closure
    } - closure
    if not additions:
        break
    closure.update(additions)

positive = ("suspects", "frog", "rhino")
negative = ("not_suspects", "frog", "rhino")

applicable = {
    name for name, premises, conclusion in rules
    if premises <= closure and conclusion in (positive, negative)
}

# Rule1 defeats Rule4 only if Rule1 is applicable to the frog.
positive_supported = positive in closure
negative_supported = negative in closure
if negative_supported and "Rule1" in applicable:
    positive_supported = False

if positive_supported and not negative_supported:
    expected = "proved"
elif negative_supported and not positive_supported:
    expected = "disproved"
else:
    expected = "unknown"

print("72 > 88:", money["frog"] > money["badger"])
print("1971 < 1987:", movie_year["frog"] < messi_birth_year)
print("13 > 9:", friends["frog"] > 9)
print("Frog neglects swallow:", ("neglects", "frog", "swallow") in closure)
print("Frog surrenders to poodle:", ("surrenders", "frog", "poodle") in closure)
print("Explicit non-surrender to mule:",
      ("not_surrenders", "frog", "mule") in closure)
print("Applicable rules about frog's suspicion:", sorted(applicable))
print("Expected result:", expected)
print("Submitted result: proved")
print("CHECK PASS" if expected == "proved" else "CHECK FAIL")
